1
Petitioners face prosecution in Crime No.1183 of 2021 of Koyilandy Police Station, Kozhikode District, for commission of offences under Section 498A read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
The 1st petitioner is the husband of the 2nd respondents.
The 2nd petitioner is the mother of the 1st petitioner and 3rd petitioner is the sister of the 1st petitioner.

The allegation against the petitioners is that while the 1st petitioner and the 2nd respondent were residing together, the 2nd respondent was subjected to matrimonial cruelty by the petitioners on the reason that she had brought only a meager quantity of gold ornaments and thereby they committed the aforesaid offences.
2.
The learned counsel appearing for the petitioners would submit that the disputes arose on account of matrimonial disputes between the 1st petitioner and the 2nd respondent.
It is submitted that all disputes between the petitioners and the 2nd respondent have been settled, as is evident from Annexure - 2 affidavit.
It is submitted that the proceedings against the petitioner in Crime No.1183 of 2021 of Koyilandy Police Station, Kozhikode District may be quashed on the basis of settlement.
CRL.MC NO. 7909 OF 2023 3.
The learned Public Prosecutor confirms that the issues between the petitioners and the 2nd respondent have been settled.

4. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, considering the nature of allegations and taking into account the contents of Annexure - 2 affidavit and the submissions of the learned Public Prosecutor, I am of the view that this is a fit case where jurisdiction of this Court under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C can be invoked and the proceedings against the petitioners can be quashed on the basis of settlement.
No public interest will be served by continuing with the proceedings against the petitioners.
Accordingly, this Crl.M.C is allowed and all further proceedings in Crime No.1183 of 2021 of Koyilandy Police Station, Kozhikode District, will stand quashed as against the petitioners.

Sd/-
GOPINATH P. JUDGE DK CRL.MC NO. 7909 OF 2023 PETITIONER ANNEXURES Annexure-1
